from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    dominant = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    other = next(value for value in counts if value != dominant)
    return [[0 if value == dominant else dominant for value in row] for row in grid]
